prologue.intro.speaker: TOPSIDE
prologue.intro.text: Morning. Welcome aboard the Tåsi. We're moored over the reef on Guam's west coast.

prologue.intro.speaker: TOPSIDE
prologue.intro.text: Quick brief. Three weeks ago our trench lander, ECHO-7, stopped transmitting from the bottom of the Mariana Trench.

prologue.intro.speaker: TOPSIDE
prologue.intro.text: This expedition surveys every zone on the way back down to it. Today you start at the top: the reef, and the wall below it.

prologue.intro.speaker: TOPSIDE
prologue.intro.text: Your gear's on the bench, starboard side. Run your checks.

prologue.gauge.speaker: TOPSIDE
prologue.gauge.text: Two hundred bar. A full cylinder.

prologue.purge.speaker: TOPSIDE
prologue.purge.text: Regulator breathes clean. You've got two second stages on that H-valve — the yellow one is your backup.

prologue.bcdIn.speaker: TOPSIDE
prologue.bcdIn.text: Jacket holds air. Now dump it.

prologue.mask.speaker: TOPSIDE
prologue.mask.text: Mask on. Head to the dive platform on the starboard quarter.

prologue.platform.speaker: TOPSIDE
prologue.platform.text: Sit on the edge, one hand on your mask, and roll back when you're ready.

prologue.entry.speaker: TOPSIDE
prologue.entry.text: Diver in the water. Take a moment.

prologue.entry.speaker: TOPSIDE
prologue.entry.text: When you're ready, head down to the reef. Watch your ascent rate on the wrist computer.

reef.shrimp.speaker: TOPSIDE
reef.shrimp.text: Hear that crackle? Snapping shrimp. Each snap is a collapsing bubble from a single claw. It's the sound of a healthy reef.

reef.scanTutorial.speaker: TOPSIDE
reef.scanTutorial.text: Hold your view on an animal to identify it. Press E to scan it into your field journal.

reef.journal.speaker: TOPSIDE
reef.journal.text: Logged. Press J any time to open the journal.

reef.colour.speaker: TOPSIDE
reef.colour.text: Notice the colours fading as you go deeper? Water absorbs red light first. Your torch is on F — it brings the colour back up close.

reef.cleaning.speaker: TOPSIDE
reef.cleaning.text: That coral head is a cleaning station. Mantas come in to have parasites picked off by small cleaner wrasse. Stay low and keep still.

reef.manta.speaker: TOPSIDE
reef.manta.text: Manta on the station. Don't chase it. Let it come to you.

reef.ghostnet.start.speaker: TOPSIDE
reef.ghostnet.start.text: You've stopped moving. Talk to me — are you snagged?

reef.ghostnet.start.speaker: TOPSIDE
reef.ghostnet.start.text: That's monofilament round your fins. Don't thrash, it tightens. Hold E for your knife and cut the strands.

reef.ghostnet.panic.speaker: TOPSIDE
reef.ghostnet.panic.text: Easy. Slow your breathing. Knife, then cut.

reef.ghostnet.done.speaker: TOPSIDE
reef.ghostnet.done.text: You're clear. That was ghost gear — lost or dumped fishing line that keeps catching animals long after it's abandoned.

reef.toWall.speaker: TOPSIDE
reef.toWall.text: Nice work. Follow the slope south to the drop-off. The wall and the wreck are below it.

reef.lowNdl.speaker: TOPSIDE
reef.lowNdl.text: Keep an eye on your no-decompression time. We've planned stops for the deep part, but don't burn it here.

diver.fastAscent.speaker: TOPSIDE
diver.fastAscent.text: Slow your ascent. Nine metres a minute or less.

diver.lowAir.speaker: TOPSIDE
diver.lowAir.text: Your gas is getting low. Start thinking about the way up.

diver.outOfAir.speaker: TOPSIDE
diver.outOfAir.text: You're out of gas! Stay calm — switching you to the safety diver's alternate. We'll bring you back to the line.

wall.arrive.speaker: TOPSIDE
wall.arrive.text: That's the drop-off. The wall falls away past a hundred metres.

wall.arrive.speaker: TOPSIDE
wall.arrive.text: The freighter sits on a ledge at about fifty. Take your time going down, and watch your gas.

wall.narcosis.speaker: TOPSIDE
wall.narcosis.text: Feeling a little fuzzy? That's nitrogen narcosis. Breathing air this deep has a mild narcotic effect, a bit like a drink or two.

wall.narcosis.speaker: TOPSIDE
wall.narcosis.text: It clears as soon as you come shallower. Move slowly and check your gauges twice.

wall.fan.speaker: TOPSIDE
wall.fan.text: Big sea fan on the wall. At this depth the reds are gone — put your torch on it.

wall.fanLit.speaker: TOPSIDE
wall.fanLit.text: There it is. That fan was red the whole time. The water takes the red light out before it ever reaches you.

wall.shark.start.speaker: TOPSIDE
wall.shark.start.text: Shark coming in from the blue. Grey reef. Stop swimming and watch it.

wall.shark.display.speaker: TOPSIDE
wall.shark.display.text: It's hunching — back arched, pectoral fins down, swimming stiff and exaggerated. That's a threat display.

wall.shark.display.speaker: TOPSIDE
wall.shark.display.text: Face it, stay calm, and back slowly toward the wall. Don't swim at it and don't sprint.

wall.shark.escalate.speaker: TOPSIDE
wall.shark.escalate.text: Easy! Slow down. Face it and back off toward the wall.

wall.shark.escalate2.speaker: TOPSIDE
wall.shark.escalate2.text: It's still agitated. Stop finning. Just face it and drift back.

wall.shark.done.speaker: TOPSIDE
wall.shark.done.text: It's moving off. That display is a warning — grey reefs use it when they feel crowded or cornered.

wall.shark.done.speaker: TOPSIDE
wall.shark.done.text: You gave it room and it lost interest. Textbook.

wall.shark.doneRough.speaker: TOPSIDE
wall.shark.doneRough.text: It's gone. That was too close. When a grey reef hunches like that, it wants space: stop, face it, and back away slowly.

wall.wreck.speaker: TOPSIDE
wall.wreck.text: That's the freighter. She went down in a typhoon decades ago with nobody aboard.

wall.wreck.speaker: TOPSIDE
wall.wreck.text: Our acoustic recorder is clamped to the forward mast. Hold E to unclip it.

wall.recorder.speaker: TOPSIDE
wall.recorder.text: Got it. That recorder has been listening down here since the spring.

wall.clue.speaker: TOPSIDE
wall.clue.text: Read me the screen... twelve kilohertz, every two seconds, last heard two hours ago.

wall.clue.speaker: TOPSIDE
wall.clue.text: That's ECHO-7's emergency pinger. It still has power. Something down there is just stopping it from talking.

wall.freeflow.start.speaker: TOPSIDE
wall.freeflow.start.text: Free-flow! Your primary is dumping gas. Switch to your backup — the yellow one on your chest.

wall.freeflow.valve.speaker: TOPSIDE
wall.freeflow.valve.text: Good, you're breathing. Now reach back and close the left valve to stop the leak.

wall.freeflow.done.speaker: TOPSIDE
wall.freeflow.done.text: Leak's stopped and you're on the backup. That cost you gas, though.

wall.freeflow.done.speaker: TOPSIDE
wall.freeflow.done.text: Start your ascent. The line runs up from the bow. We'll run your stops on the way.

wall.lowGas.speaker: TOPSIDE
wall.lowGas.text: Watch your gas. Head for the line at the bow and start up.

ascent.start.speaker: TOPSIDE
ascent.start.text: On the line. Up you come — nine metres a minute, no faster. First stop is at twelve.

ascent.stop12.speaker: TOPSIDE
ascent.stop12.text: Twelve metres. Hold here. Keep inside the band on your gauge — the current will try to move you.

ascent.stop9.speaker: TOPSIDE
ascent.stop9.text: Nine metres. Same again. The timer only runs while you're in the band.

ascent.stop6.speaker: TOPSIDE
ascent.stop6.text: Six metres. The crew hung a spare cylinder on the line here — switch onto it, you'll want the gas.

ascent.next.speaker: TOPSIDE
ascent.next.text: Good. Up to the next stop, slowly.

ascent.slow.speaker: TOPSIDE
ascent.slow.text: Slow down! Nine metres a minute. That adds time to your next stop.

ascent.shallow.speaker: TOPSIDE
ascent.shallow.text: You're above the stop — drop back down into the band.

ascent.line.speaker: TOPSIDE
ascent.line.text: Stay with the line. The current is stronger away from it.

ascent.hangTank.speaker: TOPSIDE
ascent.hangTank.text: That's a full cylinder. Breathe easy.

ascent.lowAir.speaker: TOPSIDE
ascent.lowAir.text: You're low on gas. There's a hang tank at six metres.

ascent.surfaceDeco.speaker: TOPSIDE
ascent.surfaceDeco.text: That's your in-water stops. We'll finish your decompression in the deck chamber — surface decompression.

ascent.surfaceDeco.speaker: TOPSIDE
ascent.surfaceDeco.text: Come straight up and get in the chamber. You have five minutes from leaving the stop.

chamber.deck.speaker: TOPSIDE
chamber.deck.text: Ladder's right here. Gear off on the move — straight to the chamber.

chamber.late.speaker: TOPSIDE
chamber.late.text: That's over five minutes. We'll switch you to the longer treatment table. Get in.

chamber.in.speaker: TOPSIDE
chamber.in.text: You're in. Door's sealed. Blowing you down to fifty feet — fifteen metres. Clear your ears as we go.

chamber.o2.speaker: TOPSIDE
chamber.o2.text: At depth. Mask on — first oxygen period. Breathe normally.

chamber.air.speaker: TOPSIDE
chamber.air.text: Mask off. Five minutes on air — that air break keeps oxygen from building up too fast.

chamber.fault.speaker: TOPSIDE
chamber.fault.text: Pressure's wandering — the exhaust valve is sticking. Use your inside valves: supply raises pressure, exhaust lowers it.

chamber.fault.speaker: TOPSIDE
chamber.fault.text: Keep the needle in the green until I can swap the valve.

chamber.faultFix.speaker: TOPSIDE
chamber.faultFix.text: Got it, valve swapped. Nice and steady. Second oxygen period — mask back on.

chamber.faultSlip.speaker: TOPSIDE
chamber.faultSlip.text: Out of the green! Bring it back — little movements on the valves.

chamber.faultReset.speaker: TOPSIDE
chamber.faultReset.text: I've got it, I'm holding it from out here. Let's try that again — take the valves when you're ready.

chamber.surface.speaker: TOPSIDE
chamber.surface.text: Oxygen done. Bringing you up to the surface now.

chamber.done.speaker: TOPSIDE
chamber.done.text: You're clear. That's the diving phase done. Get some rest.

chamber.done.speaker: TOPSIDE
chamber.done.text: In two days we take the pod down to ECHO-7.

launch.intro.speaker: TOPSIDE
launch.intro.text: Two days on. We're holding station over the Challenger Deep, eleven kilometres of water under the keel.

launch.intro.speaker: TOPSIDE
launch.intro.text: The pod's in her cradle on the aft deck. Climb in and run the pre-dive checklist.

launch.inside.speaker: TOPSIDE
launch.inside.text: Checklist's on the overhead panel, left to right: hatch seal, life support, CO₂ scrubber, ballast, comms.

launch.order.speaker: TOPSIDE
launch.order.text: Hold on — keep to the checklist order.

launch.life.speaker: TOPSIDE
launch.life.text: Life support on. The sphere holds one atmosphere inside — surface pressure, all the way to the bottom.

launch.life.speaker: TOPSIDE
launch.life.text: That's why you won't need any decompression from here on.

launch.scrubber.speaker: TOPSIDE
launch.scrubber.text: Scrubber fan running. It pulls the carbon dioxide you breathe out of the cabin air.

launch.ballast.speaker: TOPSIDE
launch.ballast.text: Ballast armed. Those steel plates take you down, and dropping them brings you home.

launch.comms.speaker: TOPSIDE
launch.comms.text: Comms check… loud and clear. Stand by for launch.

launch.lift.speaker: TOPSIDE
launch.lift.text: Lifting. Swinging you out over the stern.

launch.water.speaker: TOPSIDE
launch.water.text: You're in the water. Swimmers have the lift line off.

launch.flood.speaker: TOPSIDE
launch.flood.text: Flood your ballast when you're ready. Hold E on the ballast switch.

launch.dive.speaker: TOPSIDE
launch.dive.text: Going down. Next stop, the twilight zone.

twilight.d60.speaker: TOPSIDE
twilight.d60.text: Sixty metres. The reds and oranges are already gone outside.

twilight.d140.speaker: TOPSIDE
twilight.d140.text: Light's fading fast. Floodlights are on F when you want them — and R pings the sonar.

twilight.d200.speaker: TOPSIDE
twilight.d200.text: Two hundred metres: the twilight zone. There's still a little daylight here, but far too little for anything to grow.

twilight.d300.speaker: TOPSIDE
twilight.d300.text: Slowing you down. There's a seamount below you — its summit is at about three hundred and fifty metres.

twilight.arrive.speaker: TOPSIDE
twilight.arrive.text: You have the controls. W and S for thrust, A and D to turn, Space and C to rise and sink.

twilight.arrive.speaker: TOPSIDE
twilight.arrive.text: Follow the flank down. Lots of animals here rise towards the surface at night and sink back down by day.

twilight.floods.speaker: TOPSIDE
twilight.floods.text: Try the floods with F. Turn them off now and then — let your eyes find what little light is left.

twilight.whale.clicks.speaker: TOPSIDE
twilight.whale.clicks.text: Hear that? Clicks on the hydrophone, about one every second. That's a sperm whale, echolocating.

twilight.whale.clicks.speaker: TOPSIDE
twilight.whale.clicks.text: They hunt squid down here. It's somewhere out in the dark.

twilight.whale.pass.speaker: TOPSIDE
twilight.whale.pass.text: There it is. Fifteen metres of whale. It's seen you long before you saw it.

twilight.co2.start.speaker: TOPSIDE
twilight.co2.start.text: CO₂ alarm. The scrubber canister's spent — the absorbent can't take any more.

twilight.co2.start.speaker: TOPSIDE
twilight.co2.start.text: Swap it: open the panel on your left, pull the old canister, put in the spare, restart the fan.

twilight.co2.insert.speaker: TOPSIDE
twilight.co2.insert.text: Spare's just below. Slot it in.

twilight.co2.done.speaker: TOPSIDE
twilight.co2.done.text: CO₂ is coming down. Breathe easy — the headache will fade.

twilight.next.speaker: TOPSIDE
twilight.next.text: That's the bottom of the twilight zone. Flood your ballast and we'll take you down into the midnight zone.
